category: news event dataset and search API

free_tier.stated: Every dataset free for unlimited and unrestricted use, with no fee: Event, Mentions and GKG CSV files every 15 minutes and the DOC 2.0 search API over a rolling 3 months, both with no key, and the same tables in Google BigQuery, which needs a Google sign-in.
free_tier.notes: The DOC 2.0 API asks for at most one request every 5 seconds and answered HTTP 429 to every call made on 2026-10-30; its 429 body points high-traffic users to the web ngrams dataset.

per_object_cap.stated: DOC 2.0 API: 75 results a request by default, 250 at most; the bulk files are zips of one 15-minute slice each

retention.stated: the DOC 2.0 API searches a rolling window of the last 3 months; the GDELT 2.0 files start on February 19, 2015

egress.terms: no fee and no key on data.gdeltproject.org; a 15-minute export zip downloaded with no account

interface_detail: plain HTTPS downloads from data.gdeltproject.org, indexed by lastupdate.txt and masterfilelist.txt; the DOC 2.0 API as GET with JSON, CSV or HTML output; the tables also sit in public Google BigQuery datasets
tooling: any HTTP client for the files and the API; a BigQuery client for the public tables
chaining: The bulk path: poll lastupdate.txt every 15 minutes and fetch the listed zips, checking each against the size the listing gives; the DOC 2.0 API serves only ad hoc searches.

limits.value: DOC 2.0 API: one request every 5 seconds; every call made on 2026-10-30 answered HTTP 429
DOC 2.0 API: 250 results a request at most, 75 by default
BigQuery route: 1 TiB of processed query data each month in the BigQuery sandbox, which needs a Google Account and a Google Cloud project but no credit card or billing account

binding_note: The DOC 2.0 API throttle is the only limit met; the bulk files carry no stated limit, so a reader that polls the files meets none.

identity_cost.detail: No account and no key: the bulk files and the DOC 2.0 API take plain GET requests, and an export zip downloaded with no credentials. The BigQuery route is not anonymous: a call to the BigQuery REST API for a GDELT table with no credential answers HTTP 401 with a Bearer challenge for accounts.google.com, so it needs a Google sign-in. The sandbox terms of that route are in the volume-quota limit row.

reliability_note: The DOC 2.0 API answered HTTP 429 to every call on 2026-10-30, from a residential ISP address and from a cloud fetch egress, with calls minutes apart. On 2026-11-02, in two series of calls hours apart, it answered HTTP 429 again to calls with different queries, from a residential ISP address under two user agents and from a cloud fetch egress; the only HTTP 200 answers were a 2-byte {} body, for two query URLs, from the residential address, and no call returned an article list. The bulk files answered 200 on both days.
confidence_note: The newest export zip listed in lastupdate.txt downloaded with no account on 2026-10-30 and on 2026-11-02, at the size the listing gives each time (106145 bytes, then 82391 bytes); the DOC 2.0 API was probed on both days and answered 429 to every call except the calls that answered 200 with a 2-byte {} body. The DOC 2.0 API ceiling stays unmeasured until a call returns articles.
